sections.description: Save posts and selected shop items by email, with optional consent-based newsletter signup.
sections.changelog:
= 0.2.3 =
* Offer Email my picks and Shop selected items with clear, editable action labels.
* Open one shared email popup with a live selected-item count and separate optional newsletter consent.
* Keep selections independent between checklists and provide individual links when a browser blocks shopping tabs.

= 0.2.2 =
* Organize settings into tabs with one Save changes action and preserve drafts between views.
* Preview post and shop emails in the delivery layout, with inline editing and desktop/mobile widths.
* Customize shop greetings, shopping links, post buttons and fallback text independently.
* Use Save to Email throughout the dashboard and block editor.

= 0.2.1 =
* Use “Save to Email” for all visible plugin, editor and settings labels.

= 0.2.0 =
* Move newsletter providers into optional shared Kit, Flodesk and Attentive add-ons.
* Show the selected provider and inactive add-on status while preserving saved account settings.
* Require the matching add-on for newsletter signup; saved email delivery continues independently.

= 0.1.0 =
* Save posts or selected shop items to email with images, titles and shopping links.
* Include optional newsletter signup, editable email branding and an accessible post-save popup.
* Keep creator settings, integrations and updates separate from the recipe Save to Email plugin.
